title: VeloraOS 1.10.31 - Instant Chat Fast Path
releaseNotes: Fixes simple greetings such as hello taking tens of seconds on Qwen3.
Automatic mode explicitly routes trivial conversational prompts to VeloraOS Tiny and bypasses Web Intelligence.
Disables Qwen3 thinking for trivial Tiny responses where supported and caps output to 128 tokens.
Keeps the selected Ollama chat model resident for 30 minutes to reduce repeated cold-load latency.
Preserves full reasoning behaviour for normal questions, Coding and Deep Thoughts.
